A1.justification: Both complete, readable 19-page PDFs describe GeoThinker. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices can be matched reliably, including relocated material.

before.justification: V3 reports original GeoThinker benchmark results, embodied-referring and driving experiments, component ablations, and additional empirical analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: V4 retains those original empirical results and adds GeoThinker evaluations on AI2D, MMB, and DSR in Tables 13–14.

M1.justification: Spatial-Grounded Fusion, frame-wise constraints, Importance Gating, Global Scaling, and layer selection remain unchanged. The spatial compression and short-sequence bypass described in Appendix B were already present in v3.

E1.justification: Appendices I–J extend the existing broad evaluation suite with AI2D and MMB general-capability tests and DSR dynamic-scene evaluation. BLINK was already covered in Table 9. Training coverage is unchanged; the MindCube-Tiny caption clarification matches the earlier appendix disclosure.

E2.justification: Table 2 adds 3DThinker-Qwen2.5-7B and SenseNova-SI-1.1 variants using Qwen3VL-8B and InternVL3-8B. The SenseNova variants already appeared in Table 9, but their inclusion in the corresponding main-text comparison is new.

E3.justification: The added DSR experiment uses zero-shot evaluation without task-specific fine-tuning and states that model scale and training data are aligned with VG-LLM-8B. Existing experiments retain their reported training budgets, frame counts, controls, and metrics.

E4.justification: Component and fusion-ratio ablations, video-mixture and frame-count studies, computational-cost analysis, and resolution tests are retained. The added benchmark tables and long-context discussion do not introduce a separate ablation or robustness analysis.

E5.justification: Repeated-run, seed, and statistical uncertainty reporting remain unchanged. The new tables provide point estimates without adding confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: Table 13 newly reports GeoThinker/Cambrian-S scores of 76.3/76.9 on AI2D and 83.3/80.4 on MMB. Table 14 adds DSR scores of 42.7 for GeoThinker, 38.4 for VG-LLM-8B, and 31.4 for VLM-3R. Table 2 adds 3DThinker results. Retained scores are unchanged; BLINK and SenseNova values repeat earlier evidence.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–5 are unchanged. V4 adds no formal assumptions, propositions, proofs, or derivations; its new scalability explanation is qualitative.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: active geometry integration, state-of-the-art spatial reasoning, and downstream generalization. The highlighted VSI-Bench score of 72.6 and downstream improvement claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: New Appendix L.1 attributes long-context extrapolation to the combination of VGGT spatial grounding and general-video training. Appendices I–J interpret added results as evidence of general capability and dynamic-scene transfer. Existing limitations concerning geometric-encoder accuracy remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix J supplies limited configuration guidance for reproducing the new DSR comparison by referencing VG-LLM-8B's model scale and training data and specifying no task-specific fine-tuning. Existing implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware information, and code-access disclosure are unchanged.

R1.justification: V4 adds citations to Think with 3D and Learning to Reason in 4D. Section 2.2 places 3DThinker alongside geometry-distillation approaches, extending the existing positioning without changing the central active-versus-passive integration argument.

P1.justification: V4 adds an author and affiliation, publication information, and acknowledgments; renames Section 2.1; and inserts appendix sections that shift the former I–J to K–L. Existing prose is largely retained, with localized additions rather than extensive rewriting.

P2.justification: V4 adds Tables 13–14, expands Table 2, and makes caption and highlighting refinements. Table 6 is repositioned, Figure 7 moves from page 17 to page 18, and surrounding content reflows. Existing figure content is unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added general-capability and DSR evaluations provide useful evidence for the retained generalization claims, while Table 2 includes additional relevant competitors. These modestly strengthen empirical support. Sparse new-protocol details, the absence of an unmodified-backbone control for capability preservation, and the untested long-context mechanism limit the strength of the added conclusions.
